description: Recordings on Canvas, slides/code in Modules. * **Office hours**  (in person + virtual): see course calendar for times/locations. All lectures will be recorded and available on Canvas. * **Office Hours:** Meet 1:1 with instructors and CAs. There are two types of CA office hours: homework OH (for help with homework questions) and general OH (to ask questions about course content from lecture). Homework parties and most office hours are in person in Huang Basement, but we will have some remote office hours (for CGOE students) on Zoom. For extra sensitive matters, you can email cs221-staff-spr2526@cs.stanford.edu, which is visible by only the instructors, head CA, course manager, and student liaison. Send this letter to cs221-staff-spr2526@cs.stanford.edu by **Friday, Apr 18 (Week 3)**.
